title: Service Record Request
description: Request payload to submit a self-reported vehicle maintenance or service record.

vehicle_id.description: Identifier of the vehicle that was serviced.

service_date.description: ISO-8601 date on which the service was performed (YYYY-MM-DD).

odometer_km.description: Odometer reading in kilometres at the time of service.

notes.description: Optional notes from the vehicle owner or technician.

receipt_ref.description: Optional external or object storage reference for receipt.

receipt_sha256.description: Optional 64-hex SHA-256 hash of the receipt file.
